name: Seven Minutes
source:
Seven Minutes in Heaven was never so strange.

Much to your dismay you're at a new years party. Callie and Alex invited you so you have to go. Doesn't matter how long you stay. Just as long as you have fun. Right?

[From [url=https://hexfox.itch.io/seven-minutes]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“天堂七分钟”从未如此古怪。

令你郁闷的是，你正身处一场新年聚会。凯莉和亚历克斯邀请了你，你也只好参加。待多久无所谓，只要玩得开心就行，对吧？

（摘自[url=https://hexfox.itch.io/seven-minutes]itch.io[/url]）
